code_edition: BS 9999:2017 stated as principal design guidance (p.2). Building Regulations 2010 Part B. BS 5839-1:2017 and BS 5839-8:2013 cited. BS EN 12845 cited without year. London Plan Policies D5(B2) and D12(B1-6) cited.

facts.text: Prepared 'in support of the Planning Application'. 'The design is at concept level and the detail has not been developed.'
Principal guidance is BS 9999:2017. 'Where these recommendations are unsuitable for the design or use of the building, additional engineering justifications will be provided.'
Fire and smoke modelling 'may be undertaken to show that the proposed solutions will work'.

B1: elements of structure either 120 minutes, or 90 minutes 'if, through a fire engineered approach, a time equivalence assessment determines this to be appropriate'. The text says 'full construction methods have not been determined and assessed'.
B2: a phased evacuation regime with two evacuation zones (podium and Crossrail Box as one; Tower as another). Travel distances, exit and stair widths are to be designed to BS 9999:2017.
B3: automatic fire detection Category L2 to BS 5839-1:2017 and BS 5839-8:2013; sprinklers to BS EN 12845; the building management is expected to meet an 'Enhanced' Level 1 regime from BS 9999.
B4: two firefighting shafts for the Tower and three for the Crossrail Box, accessed from Paddington Central Estate Road, with a fire control centre at fire-service access level.
Policy D5(B2) evacuation lifts: the statement says 'The Fire Surgery can confirm that evacuation lifts will be provided with at least one per core.'
The overall strategy 'will have a reliance on sound management of the building', and specific management requirements 'will be highlighted to the client as they are developed'.
